lines.en: label mollyfirsthall:
scene mollyhall1
: Hey, Molly. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Molly。你在忙什么呢？

lines.en: : Afternoon, Sir!
lines.zh: : 午安，先生！

lines.en: : I decided to be adventurous this fine evening and journey outside of my room.
lines.zh: : 这个美好的傍晚，我决定冒险一回，走出我的房间去远行。

lines.en: : Oh, really? Are you going somewhere?
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？那你是要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Negative, Sir. This is as far as I am willing to go.
lines.zh: : 否定，先生。我最多只愿意走到这里。

lines.en: : In order to break the NEET mold, I must stand in this very hallway for at least an hour once a week.
lines.zh: : 为了打破家里蹲的刻板印象，我必须每周至少在这条走廊上站满一个小时。

lines.en: : What a coincidence that you just happened to show up on that very day!
lines.zh: : 您偏偏就在那一天出现了，这可真是巧合啊！

lines.en: : I mean, I show up on other days too. I don’t think it’s that strange of a coincidence.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我别的日子也会出现。我觉得这巧合没那么离谱吧。

lines.en: scene mollyhall2
: Tell me, Sir. Do you believe in fate?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，先生。您相信命运吗？

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve answered this question for someone else before.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个问题我之前已经为别人回答过一次了。

lines.en: : I believe, Sir. I believe we were fated to meet in this very hallway.
lines.zh: : 我相信，先生。我相信我们是命中注定要在这条走廊上相遇的。

lines.en: : This is a gift from the Heavens above! Or the Hells below! Whichever you believe in!
lines.zh: : 这是来自天上天堂的恩赐！还是来自地下地狱的馈赠！您信哪个就算哪个！

lines.en: : And if we don’t believe in either?
lines.zh: : 要是两个都不信呢？

lines.en: : Then find something to believe in!
lines.zh: : 那就去找点可以相信的东西！

lines.en: : Or better yet, believe in me!
lines.zh: : 要不更进一步——相信我吧！

lines.en: : Oh! Even better than that-
lines.zh: : 哦！还有比那更好的——

lines.en: : Believe in the me that believes in you!
lines.zh: : 去相信那个相信着您的我吧！

lines.en: : Molly, what the fuck are you even talking about?
lines.zh: : Molly，你他妈到底在说什么啊？

lines.en: scene mollyhall3
: I JUST SHOTGUNNED A MONSTER AND I’M READY TO KICK ASS! LET’S GO!
lines.zh: : 我刚刚用霰弹枪轰掉了一只怪物，现在正准备大杀四方！上啊！

lines.en: : If you’re going to ask someone to believe in {i}you{/i} instead of heaven or hell, you’re going to need better reasoning than “I just shotgunned a monster.”
lines.zh: : 你要是想让人家相信{i}你{/i}，而不是相信天堂或地狱，那总得拿出比「我刚用霰弹枪轰了只怪物」更像样的理由吧。

lines.en: scene mollyhall2
: Let’s face it, Sir. You’ll believe in Molly MacCormack whether she gives you a good reason or not.
lines.zh: : 面对现实吧，先生。不管 Molly MacCormack 给不给您像样的理由，您都会相信她的。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 凭什么这么说？

lines.en: scene mollyhall4
: Because cute girls are more powerful than God! Especially ones with green thigh-high’s named Molly!
lines.zh: : 因为可爱的女孩子比上帝更强大！尤其是那个穿着绿色过膝袜、名叫 Molly 的！

lines.en: : And as further proof, I’ll have you know that I {i}killed{/i} several gods just earlier today in a video game I was playing.
lines.zh: : 再补充一条铁证：就在今天早些时候，我在玩的一款游戏里{i}干掉{/i}了好几个神。

lines.en: : So if that’s not enough reason for you to worship me, I don’t know what is.
lines.zh: : 所以要是这都不足以成为您崇拜我的理由，那我真不知道还有什么够了。

lines.en: : Are you...starting a cult or something?
lines.zh: : 你……是在搞什么邪教之类的吗？

lines.en: scene mollyhall5
: Yeah. But it’s a totally wholesome one and I’m not going to ask you to pray or donate or anything.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过这是个非常健康向上的教团，我不会要求您祈祷、捐钱什么的。

lines.en: : We can just hang out, eat junk food, and watch movies.
lines.zh: : 我们就一起玩、吃垃圾食品、看电影就好。

lines.en: : That...actually sounds like a pretty sweet deal.
lines.zh: : 这……听起来倒是个挺不错的买卖。

lines.en: : The sweetest deal, Sir.
lines.zh: : 最划算的买卖，先生。

lines.en: : And where can I sign up for this so-called “Cult of Molly?”
lines.zh: : 那这个所谓的「Molly 教」要去哪儿报名？

lines.en: scene mollyhall4
: All I need is eight ounces of your blood. That is enough to perform the ritual.
lines.zh: : 我只需要您八盎司的血。举行仪式这些就够了。

lines.en: scene mollyhall5
: I’ll also need you to sign a few papers.
lines.zh: : 另外还需要您签几份文件。

lines.en: : I like to keep things organized, Sir. And without proper documentation for each and every member, things are bound to get wild.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢把事情弄得井井有条，先生。要是没有给每一位成员都建好正规档案，局面肯定会失控的。

lines.en: : Just look at Christianity, Sir. There are like ten different kinds now. Would that really have happened if everyone had to sign a form?
lines.zh: : 就拿基督教来说吧，先生。现在都分化出十来种了。要是当初每个人都得签张表，还会变成这样吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...Probably?
lines.zh: : 呃……大概会吧？

lines.en: scene mollyhall2
: Nonsense! Malarky!
lines.zh: : 胡说八道！一派胡言！

lines.en: : Real religion is like a gym membership. You sign up ‘cause you think it’s cool and then wind up forgetting about it and ultimately stop caring altogether.
lines.zh: : 真正的宗教就像健身房的会员卡。你办卡是因为觉得挺酷，然后慢慢就把它忘了，最后彻底不在乎了。

lines.en: : The Cult of Molly, though...That’s where things become different.
lines.zh: : 不过 Molly 教嘛……那就完全不一样了。

lines.en: scene mollyhall4
: Together, we’ll usher in the end of times! The last of days! The...ending of...stuff!
lines.zh: : 我们一起，将开启末日的序幕！最后的岁月！那个……各种东西的……终结！

lines.en: : You need to chill out with the energy drinks, Molly. Your enthusiasm is going to tear this place down.
lines.zh: : 你得少喝点能量饮料，Molly。你这份热情快把这地方掀翻了。

lines.en: scene mollyhall3
: Let it burn for all I care! I’ll move in with you and Ami!
lines.zh: : 烧就烧吧，我才不在乎！我可以搬去跟您和 Ami 一起住！

lines.en: : You two would have to sleep in the same bed.
lines.zh: : 那你们俩就得睡同一张床了。

lines.en: scene mollyhall6
: I hope she likes cuddling, Sir. I tend to grab onto things when I sleep, you see.
lines.zh: : 希望她喜欢抱着人睡，先生。您看，我睡觉的时候总爱抓着点什么东西。

lines.en: : It’s a habit I’ve had since birth.
lines.zh: : 这是我从出生起就有的习惯。

lines.en: : I think it’s because I’m so full of love that it possesses me in my sleep.
lines.zh: : 我想是因为我体内装的爱太多了，连睡着的时候都会被它附身。

lines.en: : It's either that or a demon.
lines.zh: : 要么是这个原因，要么就是有恶魔。

lines.en: : It could be either one, Sir.
lines.zh: : 两种都有可能，先生。

lines.en: : That’s nice, Molly.
lines.zh: : 真不错啊，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyhall7
: Gah!
lines.zh: : 呀啊！

lines.en: Molly’s cell phone suddenly rings from inside of her pocket, causing her to jump up in surprise.
lines.zh: Molly 的手机突然在她口袋里响了起来，吓得她猛地跳了起来。

lines.en: scene mollyhall8
: Who the heck is textin’ me at this time of night? Don’t they know that the latest update is supposed to drop in-
lines.zh: : 谁他妈大半夜的给我发消息啊？他们不知道最新版本就要在——

lines.en: scene mollyhall9
: AH! RIGHT NOW!
lines.zh: : 啊！就是现在！

lines.en: scene mollyhall10
: Sir...I apologize for cutting this meeting short, but it appears that I have prior engagements.
lines.zh: : 先生……很抱歉要提前结束这次会面，不过看来我另有约会在身。

lines.en: : Go play your game, Molly. I’ll just find something else to do.
lines.zh: : 去打你的游戏吧，Molly。我再找点别的事做就是了。

lines.en: : Roger. Please feel free to visit me again soon, though!
lines.zh: : 收到。不过请您务必尽快再来找我！

lines.en: : Preferably on a day where I don’t have games to play!
lines.zh: : 最好挑个我没游戏要打的日子！

lines.en: scene mollyhall11
: How am I supposed to know when that is?
lines.zh: : 我上哪儿知道那是哪天啊？

lines.en: scene black
I wind up walking around the area surrounding the dorms for a few minutes afterward, hoping to bump into another familiar face.
lines.zh: 之后我在宿舍周围逛了几分钟，希望能撞见另一张熟面孔。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I don’t find anything and am forced to go home early...
lines.zh: 可惜什么也没找到，只好提前回家……

lines.en: Oh well, I guess.
lines.zh: 算了，我想。

lines.en: At least Molly’s probably having a good night.
lines.zh: 至少 Molly 今晚大概过得很开心。
